categories.name: Embedding-based Methods
categories.description: Learn knowledge graph embeddings to encode entities and relations for reasoning.

categories.name: Retrieval-based Methods
categories.description: Retrieve relevant subgraphs from the knowledge graph based on question semantics.

categories.name: Reinforcement Learning Methods
categories.description: Use RL to optimize reasoning policies or trajectory selection for multi-hop QA.

categories.name: Trajectory-based RL Optimization
categories.description: Frame multi-hop reasoning as trajectory generation and optimize using policy gradient methods with intermediate supervision.

categories.name: Ontology-guided Retrieval with Iterative Refinement
categories.description: Use ontology graphs to guide retrieval and iteratively refine evidence paths under question context.

categories.name: Context-enriched Triple Training
categories.description: Enrich target triples with additional triples from the same source passage to form local context subgraphs for training.

categories.name: Adaptive Repair Loop for One-hop Failures
categories.description: Iteratively detect and correct one-hop prediction errors by generating corrective examples.

categories.name: Lower-hop Transfer Learning
categories.description: Pre-train on simpler (lower-hop) QA instances and transfer to deeper multi-hop reasoning via RL optimization.

idea_position: Context-enriched Triple Training with Adaptive Repair Loop and Lower-hop Transfer
common_assumptions: The knowledge graph contains sufficient relational information to support multi-hop reasoning.
Question answering performance can be improved by better utilization of KG structure and semantics.
Reasoning trajectories or evidence paths can be refined to reduce noise and improve accuracy.

repeated_limitations.description: Dependence on quality of auxiliary components (e.g., prompt-generated trajectories, ontology graph) affects overall performance.
LLMs may hallucinate or generate unsupported facts when lacking explicit graph-grounded evidence.

underexplored_combinations: Combining context subgraph enrichment with ontology-guided retrieval mechanisms
Integrating adaptive repair loops with trajectory-based RL optimization approaches
Using lower-hop transfer learning with context-enriched triple training for improved generalization
